cards.title: 3 versions
cards.text: I run a hair salon. Write 3 versions of a text reminding Maya of her appointment tomorrow at 2pm: 1) very short 2) warm 3) with how to reschedule. Under 30 words each.

messages.text:
1) Hi Maya, reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 2pm. See you then!

2) Hi Maya! Just a friendly reminder that we'll see you tomorrow at 2pm. Can't wait to catch up!

3) Hi Maya, see you tomorrow at 2pm. Need to reschedule? Just reply to this text and we'll find a new time.
Hi Maya! See you tomorrow at 2pm. Need a different time? Just reply here and we'll sort it out.

caption:
Ask AI for 3 options instead of 1: a simple prompt tip for better drafts

With one answer, you either take it or start over. With three, you can pick one, mix two, and steer the result.

Copy this:

"Write 3 versions of [WHAT YOU NEED]: 1) [STYLE A, E.G. VERY SHORT] 2) [STYLE B, E.G. WARM] 3) [STYLE C, E.G. WITH NEXT STEP]. Under [NUMBER] words each."

Then reply with something like "Mix 2 and 3, shorter."

I tried it on an appointment reminder for an invented salon. Version 3 had the reschedule line, version 2 had the warmth. The mix had both, in 19 words.

The trick: make the three different on purpose (length, tone or angle), or you'll get the same answer three times.
